column2: Hey, you lot... Do you have families?
We $$上級神官$$s who guard the $$バベルの塔$$
all strongly inherit the $$大天使$$s' $$血$$ and are $$両性具有$$!
We would never have children with anyone!
You understand why I cannot return your feelings...
